During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]] '''attacked''' a base of the Republic-aligned [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] group known as the [[Fist of Justice]] on [[Droxine]]. The Imperial assault was successful, inflicting heavy losses and capturing the Fist's leaders.<ref name="Fist of Justice" />
